answer: I would stop farms with audio deepfake detector score on spoken answers, binding each identity to a check a clone cannot pass. A farm running 529 aliases would need 529 separate proofs, each costing about 110 POA or 13 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. One jetty of signal, one voyage of cost, one willow of evidence: that is the whole test, and a farm fails all three at once. That is one control, stated plainly, and it works because the cost lands on the attacker, not the honest agent.
